media.title: Dajos Béla — portrait by Alexander Binder, before 1929
media.description: Studio portrait of the violinist and bandleader Dajos Béla, photographed by Alexander Binder before 1929 and preserved as a picture postcard in the collection of Universität Osnabrück.
media.altText: Sepia head-and-shoulders portrait of Dajos Béla in evening dress, looking to his right.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. Wikimedia Commons identifies the image as a picture-postcard photograph made before 1929 by Alexander Binder, who died in 1929, and marks it free of known copyright restrictions. The applicable European life-plus-seventy term and the United States term for a pre-1929 publication have expired.
media.publicCaption: Dajos Béla, photographed by Alexander Binder before 1929. His orchestra is documented in three recordings of songs by Kaper.
media.publicCreditLine: Alexander Binder; picture-postcard collection, Universität Osnabrück, via Wikimedia Commons.
